prompt: Create an animated 2D mechanism SVG in standalone HTML explaining an OAuth 2.0 PKCE handshake between Browser App, Auth Server, and Token Endpoint (1: Auth Request + Code Challenge, 2: Auth Code, 3: Code + Verifier -> Access Token). Use semantic CSS tokens for light and dark mode, <defs> gradients/markers, accessible <title>/<desc>, Play/Pause button, and reduced-motion support.
